source: Meta Erdős: independently proposed candidate questions; not posed by Erdős

problems.title: Prime-spectrum saturation
problems.question: Does the maximum distinct-prime-sum deficit of a prime-sum perfect matching stay bounded?
problems.result: Interior prime sums realized by a partial matching; completion is open in this study
problems.verification: Exact small matching optimization

problems.title: Prime-sum matching reconfiguration
problems.question: Are all prime-sum perfect matchings joined by four-cycle switches?
problems.result: One connected component through n=12 in exhaustive tests
problems.verification: Enumerated 423,884 matchings at n=12 in initial exploration

problems.title: Edge-disjoint prime-sum matchings
problems.question: Is the maximum perfect-matching packing equal to the host graph's minimum degree?
problems.result: Equivalent to a min-cut condition for an arithmetic bipartite factor
problems.verification: Integral max flow tested to n=3,000 (finite only)

problems.title: Sidon exchange connectivity
problems.question: Are size-k Sidon sets connected by feasible one-mark exchanges below the square-root scale?
problems.result: Elementary connectivity theorem for N > 2(2k-1)^3
problems.verification: Small disconnected/connected cases enumerated

problems.title: Coprime permutation switches
problems.question: Can all permutations satisfying gcd(i,σ(i))=1 be connected by valid two-position swaps?
problems.result: No universal-row/column shortcut; arithmetic structure is essential
problems.verification: 3,459,600 states at n=14, one component

problems.title: Sidon sets without prime differences
problems.question: What is the asymptotic maximum size of a Sidon set whose positive differences avoid all primes?
problems.result: Asymptotic lower constant at least 1/√2 and upper at most 1
problems.verification: Small exact MILP optima through N=60

problems.title: Coprime path difference spectrum
problems.question: Can a coprime Hamiltonian path attain the parity upper bound for distinct adjacent differences?
problems.result: Full graceful existence iff n≤5 is a published 2021 theorem; extremal extension unverified
problems.verification: Exact finite MILP checks in selected sizes

problems.title: Arithmetic centering of coprime percolation
problems.question: Can the critical connectivity center be approximated by a specified non-tautological arithmetic expansion?
problems.result: Internal threshold/Gumbel arguments require external proof and priority audit
problems.verification: Finite degree-profile and center checks

problems.title: Two-prime palette pairings
problems.question: Can 1,…,2n always be paired using at most two distinct prime sums?
problems.result: One-color iff 2n+1 prime; two-color certificate from short prime difference
problems.verification: Sieve certificates through n=1,000,000 (finite only)

problems.title: Minimum coprime adjacencies
problems.question: What is the exact minimum number of adjacent coprime pairs in a permutation of 1,…,n? (Resolved internally.)
problems.result: Exact path-cover formula and asymptotic proved in the repository; manuscript submitted to Integers
problems.verification: Constructive proof with prime-factor paths; explicit witnesses checked n≤10,000

problems.title: Random sum-diagonal matching transitions
problems.question: In random sum-diagonal bipartite graphs, how do perfect matchings and min-degree factor saturation emerge?
problems.result: Random sum-graphs are known; matching and factor phase behavior not located; factor saturation not monotone
problems.verification: Explicit three-by-three obstruction to monotonicity; no asymptotic claims

sources.name: Balachandran–Kush (2021), matching in random bipartite graphs

problems.title: Coprime matching-space percolation
problems.question: At what densities do the perfect matchings of a thinned coprime graph form one four-cycle reconfiguration component?
problems.result: Connects P005 matching switches to P008 arithmetic thinning; phase diagram not yet determined
problems.verification: Frozen-edge obstruction identified; unique-matching and nonmonotonicity caveats

problems.title: Random-site Sidon exchange geometry
problems.question: Can Sidon-set existence and feasible one-element-exchange connectivity have different transition regimes inside a random subset of [N]?
problems.result: Random Sidon decision phase behavior is known; feasible exchange components form a distinct proposed observable
problems.verification: k=2 degenerate connectivity checked conceptually; no large-case claim

problems.title: Homology of random Cayley sum flag complexes
problems.question: Do clique complexes of random Cayley sum graphs over cyclic prime groups have the same homology-vanishing exponents as Erdős–Rényi flag complexes?
problems.result: Exact triangle expectation matches Erdős–Rényi; four-clique expectation has an additive-parallelogram correction
problems.verification: Exact enumeration of K4 motif moments for odd cyclic orders 5, 7, 9

sources.name: Kahle (2009), topology of random clique complexes

problems.title: Odd-area lattice triangulation flip connectivity
problems.question: Are all odd-normalized-area triangulations of a convex lattice polygon connected by odd-area-preserving diagonal flips when all four mod-2 vertex residues occur?
problems.result: Odd doubled area iff the triangle has three different mod-2 vertex classes; flips require all four classes
problems.verification: Exhaustive parity color patterns through n=9 (zero disconnected four-class cases); six-vertex three-color obstruction

sources.name: Baur et al., coloured triangulation flip graphs (2025)

problems.title: Topology of the Sidon simplicial complex
problems.question: Does each fixed-dimensional reduced homology group of the simplicial complex of all Sidon subsets of [N] vanish for all sufficiently large N?
problems.result: Minimal nonfaces have size 3 or 4; exact F2 Betti numbers exhibit migration from lower to higher dimensions
problems.verification: Exact augmented boundary-rank computations through N=23; no asymptotic vanishing claim

sources.name: Superdock (2023), Sidon sets and simplicial configurations

problems.title: Random divisibility-poset chain height
problems.question: Does the longest divisibility chain in a Bernoulli random subset of [N] have a deterministic limiting length after division by log₂ N?
problems.result: For fixed 0<p<1, the normalized height is asymptotically between p and 1 in probability; convergence to a constant is unproved
problems.verification: Exact dynamic program cross-checked against all subsets for N≤9; exploratory sampling at larger N

sources.name: Lewis–Souza (2021), dimension of the divisibility order

problems.title: Conserved-XOR basis exchange fibers
problems.question: What exchange size is necessary to connect vector-space bases with a fixed XOR total, and how does connectivity change under random deletion of available vectors?
problems.result: Single-element moves cannot preserve XOR; two-exchange fibers are connected for all W at d=4 but can be disconnected at d=5
problems.verification: All 32,768 available sets at d=4 checked, plus explicit ten-vector d=5 counterexample with components 4 and 2

sources.name: Reconfiguration of basis pairs in regular matroids (2026)

problems.title: Exchange complexity of optimal no-three-in-line configurations
problems.question: Does a universal bound exist on the number of points that must be simultaneously replaced to connect all maximum-size no-three-in-line subsets of an n×n grid?
problems.result: When the maximum size is 2n, single-point exchanges are impossible and two-point exchanges are rectangle switches
problems.verification: Exact optimal configuration exchange graphs through n=7; minimal connecting move sizes 2,4,3,5,6 for n=3,...,7

problems.title: Cokernel laws of random p-adic Hankel matrices
problems.question: Does the cokernel of an n×n Haar-random p-adic Hankel matrix converge in distribution to a describable measure on finite abelian p-groups?
problems.result: Classical Hankel corank law; internally proved cyclic/two-generator probabilities and all-k elementary-abelian cokernel probabilities
problems.verification: Exact modular group counts at p=2 (n≤4), p=3 (n≤3); kernel-product rank proved from Yiasemides (2024)

sources.name: Yiasemides (2024), characteristic polynomials and Hankel kernels

problems.title: Random Cayley-sum sandpile groups
problems.question: Does the Sylow-ell sandpile group of a random prime-cyclic Cayley-sum graph converge to a law different from Erdős–Rényi?
problems.result: Precisely defined correlated graph-Laplacian cokernel; no limiting group law yet proved
problems.verification: Model and connectivity-conditioning requirements specified; exact Smith-form experiments pending

sources.name: Wood (2017), sandpile groups of random graphs

problems.title: Random unimodular triangle complex homology
problems.question: What are homology regimes for random lattice-site complexes whose two-faces have normalized area one?
problems.result: At N=1 with all four vertices kept the complex is the tetrahedral boundary, with reduced H2 nonzero
problems.verification: Exact elementary N=1 example only; finite Betti experiments pending

problems.title: Rank of random prime-divisibility incidence matrices
problems.question: When do independently retained prime-incidence vectors of integers up to N span all small-prime coordinates over F2?
problems.result: Full rank iff no nonzero prime-parity functional annihilates all retained columns; exact zero-row probability
problems.verification: Deterministic parity characterization proved; probabilistic threshold unproved

problems.title: Zero forcing on the divisor comparability graph
problems.question: What is the asymptotic zero-forcing number of the divisibility comparability graph on integers 1,...,N?
problems.result: The primes above N/2 are twin leaves, yielding Z(D_N) >= pi(N)-pi(N/2)-1
problems.verification: Elementary rigorous lower bound; exact finite zero-forcing computations pending

problems.title: Cyclic lcm Hamiltonian bottleneck
problems.question: Does closing the permutation into a cycle preserve the known N²/(4 log N) minimum adjacent-lcm bottleneck asymptotic?
problems.result: Erdős–Freud–Hegyvári (1983) already prove the linear-path asymptotic; cyclic-only variation remains under review
problems.verification: Elementary lower bound recovered; no independent cyclic upper bound

problems.title: Four-cycle generation in prime-sum bipartite graphs
problems.question: Do the four-cycles of the bipartite prime-sum graph generate its entire binary cycle space for every n, and how efficiently can its cycles be filled by squares?
problems.result: Exact finite-field elimination gives vanishing square-filled first homology for n up to 60; no proof for all n
problems.verification: Exhaustive enumeration of all four-cycles and their GF(2) boundary span; reproducible standard-library code
problems.priority: new candidate; arithmetic topology / toric overlap risk

sources.name: Prime Sum Graphs and the Induced Trees They Contain (2025)

problems.title: Mixing of maximum primitive-set exchanges
problems.question: Determine the mixing-time order and possible cutoff for single-chain heat-bath dynamics on maximum primitive subsets of [2n].
problems.novelty: not certified; closely related to counting primitive sets and distributive-lattice walks
problems.result: An internally proved exact Hamming-distance theorem and diameter formula give diameter 5n/12+O(1); mixing remains unproved
problems.verification: Exact exhaustive graph distances for 2n≤20, agreeing with the theorem
problems.priority: promising; exact structural theorem and high literature proximity

sources.name: Heat-bath random walks with Markov bases (2018)

problems.title: Möbius deformation from random divisibility complexes
problems.question: What are the asymptotic mean and fluctuations of the Euler characteristic of Bernoulli-thinned integer divisibility order complexes?
problems.novelty: not certified; arithmetic Dirichlet convolution and order-complex Möbius theory are classical
problems.result: Internally derived exact Euler-characteristic expectation with Dirichlet series p(zeta−1)/(1+p(zeta−1)); p=1 recovers the Mertens function
problems.verification: Exact enumerative small-N checks and independent coefficient recurrence
problems.priority: promising; analytic number theory and random topology

sources.name: Nontrivial divisor functions and ordered factorizations

problems.title: Prime-supported permutation X-ray fiber reconfiguration
problems.question: Is there a universal bounded-size exchange connecting every fiber of prime-sum permutations with the same anti-diagonal X-ray?
problems.novelty: high overlap risk with existing permutation X-ray/discrete tomography theory
problems.result: No two-position swap can preserve a nontrivial exact sum multiset; an explicit prime-supported fiber with two members differs at four positions
problems.verification: Exhaustive prime-sum matching fiber enumeration for n≤13; dependency-free script
problems.priority: high-overlap reserve pending Markov-basis source review

problems.title: Double-prime perfect matchings on integer intervals
problems.question: Does a perfect matching exist for every even n≥8 in the graph of integer pairs whose sum and absolute difference are both prime?
problems.novelty: not certified; prime sum/difference cycles have explicit earlier study
problems.result: Every odd n is impossible by parity; exact finite matchings exist for every even n in [8,400], while n=2,4,6 fail
problems.verification: Dependency-free exact bipartite matching checker for every even n≤400 and parity obstruction
problems.priority: promising; arithmetic Hall obstruction with direct Hamiltonicity predecessor
